assessor_provenance.model: OpenAI ChatGPT/Codex; exact serving identifier not exposed
assessor_provenance.validation: All answer values checked twice; 392 flagged answers reviewed in full; all provisional ambiguities rechecked. No independent human validation or measured assessor error rate.
assessor_provenance.masking: Only masked answer text used for coding; no mapping or reference outcomes consulted before label freeze. Answer wording can reveal the workflow; prior project context is available.

measurement_interpretation: Communicated-decision agreement with authored reference decisions; no inference of factual correctness beyond that task criterion; no independent human validation or measured coder error rate.

simultaneous_family.qualification: Quality bounds are conditional on independent trajectories; token component is approximate.

intersection_union.qualification: The conjunction controls false joint support when each test is valid; the three lower bounds do not have simultaneous 95% coverage.

blockers: Pilot replication is below the declared minimum for nuisance estimation
Complete pilot recipient annotation is required before empirical allocation
allocation_reconstruction.interpretation: Planner stopped before any simulation. This is an eligibility failure, not an empirical demonstration that every candidate is unaffordable or statistically inadequate.

ordinary.interpretation: Finite-snapshot ratio includes donor costs; conditional on decision coding and fixture references; excludes host/human/adoption costs.

eal.interpretation: Finite-snapshot ratio includes donor costs; conditional on decision coding and fixture references; excludes host/human/adoption costs.

practical_conclusion.reason: Prospectively labelled nuisance-estimation pilot; no independent evaluation sample and retained unresolved coding. Inference assumes independent reruns within fixed authored tasks/model/tool cells.

limitations: AI coding has no independently measured error rate; ambiguity envelopes do not include errors in resolved labels.
The 48 strata are fixed conditions; six tasks are authored cases, not an independently sampled task population.
Sessions within trajectories may be dependent; all 192 planned trajectory units remain in inference and ambiguity bounds.
Independence of live trajectory reruns and provider-interference absence are assumptions rather than demonstrated properties.
Full-workflow comparison bundles supplied conclusions, notes and information differences; it does not isolate language notation.
Engineering thresholds of 90% correctness, a five-percentage-point loss margin and 20% token reduction have no validated developer utility mapping.
